duplicate.rationale: No retrieval-augmentation concept exists in this corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: NeurIPS 2020 paper with DOI; fully checkable.

durability.rationale: The founding formulation of retrieval-augmented generation — parametric seq2seq memory combined with a dense non-parametric index via a neural retriever — remains the reference point for the entire pattern five years on.

actionability.rationale: The recipe and both formulations (per-sequence versus per-token retrieval conditioning) are specified precisely enough to guide an implementation and the full paper is linked.
